title: Bubur Untuk Seorang
genre: Malay 1950s exotica lounge (vibraphone-and-flute space-age bachelor-pad pop)
subject: a woman living alone who suddenly boils a full periuk of bubur kacang hijau on a Tuesday afternoon for no occasion and spends the week eating it at every meal
caption: Malay 1950s exotica lounge, space-age bachelor-pad pop. Shimmering vibraphone chords with slow motor vibrato, alto flute lines between phrases, plucked nylon-string guitar, walking upright bass, brushed snare with a light shuffle. Warm tape sound with a little spring reverb. Female lead with a warm mid alto, clearly sung, light male harmony on chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, F major. Wry, easy solo afternoon. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM, no electric guitar distortion.
lyrics:
[Intro - vibraphone and alto flute]
[Verse 1]
Selasa petang, tak ada apa
Aku rendam kacang hijau secawan
Rupanya secawan jadi seperiuk
Santan, gula melaka, daun pandan
[Chorus]
Bubur untuk seorang
Cukup untuk satu kampung
Aku makan pagi, makan petang
Periuk masih separuh penuh
[Verse 2]
Rabu aku panaskan, tambah santan
Khamis aku makan dengan roti
Jumaat aku bekukan dalam bekas
Sabtu aku masih makan lagi
[Chorus]
Bubur untuk seorang
Tak ada sebab, tak ada tetamu
Aku makan sambil tengok hujan
Periuk tinggal satu senduk
[Outro - vibraphone and flute fade]
Minggu depan mungkin pengat
Kali ni aku rendam separuh
